Name: Unofficial SVE 1.15 Tree - Earthy Recolour Patch
Author: shatteredEssence
Description:
Based off of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour[/url].
Recolours new trees added to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]'s 1.15 update.

Does not contain other files belonging to the SVE mod.
Overwrite the SVE mod folder with the files included.


[img]https://i.imgur.com/X6HrTcw.png[/img]


Will remove mod when official or more complete recolours are released.
May make adjustments upon request for users.
Feel free to take edits and use in your own patches or mods.

All images in patch belong to SVE authors and ConcernedApe.
